name: GetFeedback
description_en:
GetFeedback is a customer-feedback brand with two materially different products: Direct for relational or transactional surveys, and Digital for in-the-moment website and app feedback. The current official transition page promotes SurveyMonkey Enterprise for CX, while explicitly saying existing GetFeedback Digital access remains supported and can renew beyond December 31, 2026.

This is therefore a transition-sensitive profile. The replacement product’s advertised features are not automatically existing GetFeedback entitlements, and a general shutdown statement would erase the continued Digital offering. Existing customers should establish their exact contract and migration scope before rebuilding surveys.
description_zh:
GetFeedback 客户反馈品牌包含两类实质不同的产品：Direct 用于关系型或交易型问卷，Digital 用于网站和应用即时反馈。当前官方过渡页推广 SurveyMonkey Enterprise 作为 CX 方案，同时明确现有 GetFeedback Digital 继续受支持，可续订至 2026 年 12 月 31 日之后。

因此本文特别保留过渡背景。后继产品宣传功能不自动成为现有 GetFeedback 权益，笼统宣称整个品牌停运也会抹去持续的 Digital 服务。现有客户重建问卷前应确认自己的合同及迁移范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Official page describes personalized relational/transactional surveys and NPS, CSAT and CES.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方页描述个性化关系／交易问卷及 NPS、CSAT、CES。

core_features.explanation_en: Official FAQ identifies website/app feedback buttons and in-app micro-surveys, with continued support.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方 FAQ 指出网站／应用反馈按钮和应用内微问卷，并说明持续支持。

core_features.explanation_en: Migration services differ for US-based and non-US customers; scope must be discussed.
core_features.explanation_zh: 美国与非美国客户的迁移服务不同，需要讨论范围。

en: Inventory the existing program before migrating
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: The official page says US-based customers can be offered data migration services, whereas non-US customers are offered manual rebuilding of top-priority surveys. Discuss actual scope with customer success, including Salesforce mappings and old response access. The vendor describes a typical transition around ninety days, but that is not a guaranteed duration for an individual account. Both are hosted services in the reviewed materials; no self-hosted or source-code license was established.
steps.zh: 官方页称可为美国客户提供数据迁移，为非美国客户手动重建优先问卷。应与客户成功团队讨论实际范围，包括 Salesforce 映射和旧回答访问。厂商描述典型过渡约九十天，但不构成某账户的时限保证。所读材料呈现托管服务，未建立自托管或源代码许可。

items.en: Existing users need continuity evidence for their own product, not a blended feature list. Digital surveys can reveal contextual friction but do not replace analytics of all users; Direct responses remain a self-selected feedback sample. Failure behavior for expired links, integration retries, historical exports and account-specific retention was not verified. The retrieved transition FAQ does not by itself establish every Direct shutdown obligation or deadline, so those remain explicit gaps rather than inferred facts.
items.zh: 现有用户需要自己产品的持续性证据，而非混合功能表。Digital 可揭示情境摩擦，但不替代所有用户行为分析；Direct 回答仍属于自选择反馈样本。过期链接、集成重试、历史导出与账户保留未核实。所读过渡 FAQ 本身不能建立 Direct 所有关闭义务或期限，因此保留明确缺口，不推断。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No current GetFeedback subscription amount, permanent free plan, trial duration or universal migration fee was established. A limited-time transition-service offer is not a permanent price promise. Digital renewal beyond December 31, 2026 is documented only for Digital already included in the customer’s access. Do not apply a SurveyMonkey price page to an old Direct/Digital agreement; request the correct renewal or replacement quote. Pricing remains unknown and not verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未建立当前 GetFeedback 订阅金额、永久免费档、试用时长或统一迁移费。限时过渡服务优惠不是永久价格承诺。2026 年 12 月 31 日之后的 Digital 续订仅针对客户已有权益包含 Digital 的情况。不要把 SurveyMonkey 定价页套到旧 Direct／Digital 协议，应索取正确续订或替代报价。价格保持未知、未核实。

sources.title: GetFeedback: Customer Experience Platform

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation only. No account execution, purchase, identity claim, price approval, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/getfeedback-ae558553/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.title_en: Inventory the existing program before migrating
sections.en: For an existing CX program, list each survey, channel, trigger, CRM field and report that the business relies on. Identify whether each belongs to Direct or Digital. Pilot one replacement survey and compare the question wording, respondent links and destination fields before retiring the original. This is migration guidance, not a claim that GetFeedback and SurveyMonkey are field-compatible. Keep a data export and an agreed cutover plan; no actual export or migration was performed here.
sections.zh: 现有 CX 项目应列出依赖的每份问卷、渠道、触发器、CRM 字段和报告，再识别属于 Direct 还是 Digital。停用原问卷前先试点一份替代问卷，比较题目、受访者链接及目标字段。这是迁移建议，不表示 GetFeedback 与 SurveyMonkey 字段兼容。保留数据导出和约定的切换计划；本文未实际导出或迁移。
